subject: Acme MAP: mutual action plan & next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick discovery

Thanks Marissa - great call today. Quick recap from my side so we have alignment before we build the MAP:

Pain / goals you heard:
- Current latency and cost for our chat features spikes under load; engineering has limited ops experience tuning quantized models.
- Need predictable per-user cost and SLA for the customer-facing assistant.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 type II + ability to run in our VPC for regulated accounts.

Decision process / timeline:
- POC to validate latency/cost tradeoffs and integration (target: 4-6 weeks).
- Product + Eng evaluation -> Procurement contract review -> Legal sign-off.
- We're aiming to decide by end of November so pilot can start mid-December.

Stakeholders:
- Jordan Miles - Product (decision lead)
- Samantha Li - InfoSec (security eval)
- Carlos Herrera - Procurement (contracting)
- Marissa / Redwood AE - commercial lead
- Aditya Rao - Redwood SE (technical POC lead)

Next steps I recommended on call:
1) Redwood to send an initial MAP and a draft SOW.
2) Schedule a POC kickoff next week with Eng and Security.
3) Redwood to share SOC 2 report and any infrastructure/network requirements.

Looking forward - I'll coordinate internal calendar invites once I get proposed times.

 - Jordan
Product Lead, Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme MAP: mutual action plan & next steps

Jordan / Samantha - thanks for the clear summary and for confirming stakeholders. I pulled together the MAP draft and SOW (attached) and outlined milestones below so we're all aligned.

High-level MAP (draft):
- Milestone 1 - POC kickoff: 2026-10-12. Owners: Jordan (Acme), Aditya (Redwood). Goal: run initial inference on representative workload and measure latency/cost.
- Milestone 2 - Config & optimization: 2026-10-26. Owner: Aditya with Acme Eng. Goal: test batching/quantization profiles and KV cache configs.
- Milestone 3 - Security review & sign-off: 2026-11-09. Owner: Samantha (Acme), Dev (Redwood). Goal: SOC 2 docs review, network diagram, and any on-prem/VPC requirements documented.
- Milestone 4 - Procurement & contract execution: target 2026-11-30. Owner: Carlos (Acme), Marissa (Redwood). Goal: finalize commercial terms and SOW.
- Milestone 5 - Pilot go-live (limited): 2026-12-15. Owner: Product + Redwood Ops. Goal: validate production traffic and SLA adherence.

Decision criteria: POC demonstrates acceptable latency under Acme's 95th percentile constraint and a unit cost that meets the procurement threshold. If POC gaps remain, we'll document mitigations and a timeline for follow-up evaluations.

What Redwood will deliver by the kickoff:
- Draft SOW and MAP (attached).
- SOC 2 Type II report and security questionnaire answers.
- Temporary sandbox keys and a short runbook for test integration.

Requested from Acme before kickoff:
- Representative dataset (or samples) and example traffic profile.
- List of Eng + Sec attendees with calendar availability for 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-14.

I attached Acme_MAP_Milestones_v1.xlsx and SOW-draft-Acme-20261005.pdf to this thread. Aditya will join the kickoff and handle the technical setup. Dev, looping you for the security document checklist.

If that timeline looks good, I'll send calendar invites for the 10/12 kickoff and upload the SOW to DocuSign for initial review.

Thanks - talk soon.

 - Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Carlos Herrera <carlos.herrera@acmeprocurement.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme MAP: mutual action plan & next steps

Marissa - thanks. A couple quick security items to ensure are in the MAP before we kickoff:
- We need the SOC 2 Type II report and the date range covered.
- Network architecture: confirm whether the POC will use hosted API calls or be deployed in our VPC. If hosted, what IP ranges should our firewall expect?
- Data retention & logging: how long are inference logs retained and what controls exist to redact PII?

Also - procurement asked that the SOW include a clear termination clause for the POC and an estimate of expected token consumption for the demo so they can budget.

I'll send suggested availability for 10/12 by EOD; Carlos will pick up contracting steps after the SOW draft.

 - Samantha
InfoSec, Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.com>, Carlos Herrera <carlos.herrera@acmeprocurement.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Acme MAP: mutual action plan & next steps (finalized draft)

Team - per our notes I've updated the attached MAP and SOW to reflect the procurement and security asks. Summary of the finalized draft below (please review and let me know any changes by COB 2026-10-08):

Finalized MAP highlights:
- POC kickoff: 2026-10-12 (2-hour remote kickoff) - agenda: goals, test dataset handoff, access & runbook. Owner: Aditya (Redwood) + Jordan (Acme).
- Technical checkpoints every two weeks during the POC (10/26 and 11/09).
- Security review completion: 2026-11-09 - deliverables: SOC 2 Type II report (attached), network diagram, and retention policy. Owner: Dev + Samantha.
- Procurement target: 2026-11-30 - SOW includes POC termination clause, estimated token usage for the demo (conservative estimate included). Owner: Carlos + Marissa.
- Go/no-go decision meeting: 2026-11-18 - Product + Eng to present evaluation; Procurement to provide commercial readiness update.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Marissa: Upload SOW to DocuSign for initial review (due 2026-10-05) - DONE (link above).
- Aditya: Prepare sandbox keys, runbook, and a short sample script for integration (due 2026-10-11).
- Jordan: Share representative dataset and traffic profile (due 2026-10-09).
- Samantha: Confirm security reviewers and requested firewall IP ranges (due 2026-10-08).
- Carlos: Provide procurement checklist and PO template (due 2026-10-15).

Please reply with any concerns. If none, I'll send calendar invitations for the 10/12 kickoff and upload the final SOW to DocuSign this afternoon.

Thanks everyone - excited to get started.

Attachments: Acme_MAP_Milestones_v1.xlsx; SOW-draft-Acme-20261005.pdf

 - Marissa Cole
